hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: The majority of crypto signals sit in a 'stress' cross‑asset regime with negative composites and elevated volatility (especially BTC, ETH, SOL, LTC). Long signals for XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, BCH, UNI, XLM and ETC have zero volatility and no alpha, indicating they are largely placeholder or fragile positions. Given the overall negative outlook and heightened systemic risk, we recommend a modest de‑risking across the board.
